description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of time related to “Reduction” and “Efficient deployment”. The chart contains two slices, labeled “Reduction” and “Efficient deployment”. The “Reduction” slice is orange and occupies approximately 69.92% of the pie, with a value of 60.9s displayed within the slice. The “Efficient deployment” slice is blue and represents approximately 30.08% of the pie, with a value of 26.2s displayed within the slice. The “Efficient deployment” slice is slightly offset from the rest of the pie. Percentage labels are included inside each slice, and a legend is not present. The slices appear ordered from largest to smallest, moving clockwise.
